
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/Superlollipop/p/23628524" title="发布于 2026-11-11 14:40">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">鞅的停时定理</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        嘟嘟嘟
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>学了一些比较有意思的东西，记录一下。</p>
<p>关于 AI ：本文使用蓝色大肥鱼进行查错和标准化，可能会有一点人机味道，保证人类贡献大于 AI。</p>
<h3 id="鞅">鞅</h3>
<p>设 <span class="math inline">\((\Omega,\mathcal F,\mathbb P)\)</span> 是概率空间。</p>
<p>随机过程 <span class="math inline">\(\{M_n\}_{n\ge 0}\)</span> 称为关于 <span class="math inline">\(\{\mathcal F_n\}\)</span> 的<strong>鞅</strong>，如果对于任意 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 存在：</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\mathbb E[|M_n|]&lt;\infty\)</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\mathbb E[M_{n+1}\mid \mathcal F_n]=M_n\)</span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<p>容易得到 <span class="math inline">\(\mathbb E[M_n]=\mathbb E[M_0]\)</span>。</p>
<h3 id="停时">停时</h3>
<p>取值于 <span class="math inline">\(\{0,1,2,\dots\}\cup\{\infty\}\)</span> 的随机变量 <span class="math inline">\(T\)</span> 称为关于 <span class="math inline">\(\{\mathcal F_n\}\)</span> 的<strong>停时</strong>，如果对每个 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span>，</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\{T\le n\}\in \mathcal F_n.
\]</div><p></p><p>设 <span class="math inline">\(\{M_n\}\)</span> 是鞅，<span class="math inline">\(T\)</span> 是停时。若满足以下任意一条：</p>
<ol>
<li>有界停时：</li>
</ol>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\exists C,\quad T\le C \quad \text{几乎必然}.
\]</div><p></p><ol start="2">
<li>有限期望 + 增量有界：</li>
</ol>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathbb E[T]&lt;\infty,
\qquad
\exists K,\quad |M_{n+1}-M_n|\le K \quad \text{对所有 }n&lt;T.
\]</div><p></p><ol start="3">
<li>一致有界：</li>
</ol>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\exists K,\quad |M_{n\wedge T}|\le K\quad \text{几乎必然},\qquad\mathbb P(T&lt;\infty)=1.
\]</div><p></p><p>那么就符合停时定理。</p>
<p>感觉记不住，感性理解一下大概就是停止时刻不会无限延伸，并且每一步的收益不会突然增长特别多。</p>
<h3 id="停时定理">停时定理：</h3>
<p>在满足上面的任意条件之一的情况下有：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathbb E[M_T]=\mathbb E[M_0].
\]</div><p></p><h3 id="势能函数">势能函数：</h3>
<p>在我们做题的时候需要构造一个势能函数，满足 <span class="math inline">\(\varphi\)</span>：使对每个非终止局面 <span class="math inline">\(A\notin\mathcal S\)</span>，</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathbb E[\varphi(A_{t+1})\mid A_t=A]=\varphi(A)-1.
\]</div><p></p><p>令</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[M_t=\varphi(A_t)+t.
\]</div><p></p><p>则对 <span class="math inline">\(t&lt;T\)</span>，</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
\mathbb E[M_{t+1}\mid \mathcal F_t]
&amp;=\mathbb E[\varphi(A_{t+1})\mid \mathcal F_t]+t+1\\
&amp;=\varphi(A_t)-1+t+1\\
&amp;=\varphi(A_t)+t\\
&amp;=M_t.
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>所以 <span class="math inline">\(M_t\)</span> 是鞅。</p>
<p>对 <span class="math inline">\(M_t\)</span> 用停时定理。</p>
<p>那么有：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathbb E[\varphi(A_T)+T] = \mathbb E[\varphi(A_0)].
\]</div><p></p><p>移项：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathbb E[T]=\mathbb E[\varphi(A_0)]-\mathbb E[\varphi(A_T)].
\]</div><p></p><p>一般 <span class="math inline">\(\mathbb E[\varphi(A_0)]\)</span> 和 <span class="math inline">\(\mathbb E[\varphi(A_T)]\)</span> 容易得到，那我们就可以得出 <span class="math inline">\(\mathbb E[T]\)</span>。</p>
<p>但是构造 <span class="math inline">\(\varphi\)</span> 函数的过程比较人类智慧。</p>
<h3 id="一些习题">一些习题：</h3>
<p>例题一：一个公平游戏，每局 <span class="math inline">\(\pm1\)</span>。规则是“第一次赢到 <span class="math inline">\(+1\)</span> 就停”。</p>
<p>感性理解一下发现不能停时定理，因为注意到 <span class="math inline">\(T\)</span> 可能趋近于 <span class="math inline">\(\infty\)</span>。</p>
<p>例题二：你初始有 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> 元，每局赢 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 元或输 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 元，概率各 <span class="math inline">\(1/2\)</span>。<br>
当你到达 <span class="math inline">\(0\)</span> 元或 <span class="math inline">\(N\)</span> 元时停止。求：</p>
<ol>
<li>最终到达 <span class="math inline">\(N\)</span> 元的概率；</li>
<li>平均玩多少局。</li>
</ol>
<p>设 <span class="math inline">\(M_t\)</span> 为第 <span class="math inline">\(t\)</span> 局之后的钱数，初始 <span class="math inline">\(M_0=k\)</span>。</p>
<p>注意到 <span class="math inline">\(\mathbb E[M_{t+1}\mid M_t]=M_t\)</span>，所以 <span class="math inline">\(M_t\)</span> 就是鞅。由于 <span class="math inline">\(0\le M_t\le N\)</span>，也就是 <span class="math inline">\(M_t\)</span> 有界。所以满足鞅的停时定理。</p>
<p>所以有：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathbb E[M_T] = \mathbb E[M_0] = k = 0\cdot\mathbb P(M_T=0)+N\cdot\mathbb P(M_T=N).
\]</div><p></p><p>将 <span class="math inline">\(\mathbb P(M_T=0)+\mathbb P(M_T=N)=1\)</span> 带入得：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathbb P(M_T=N)=\frac{k}{N}.
\]</div><p></p><p>第二问求停时，那肯定得停时定理。</p>
<p>考虑设计一下 <span class="math inline">\(\varphi\)</span> 函数。</p>
<p>既然需要满足</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathbb E[\varphi(A_{t+1})\mid A_t=A]=\varphi(A)-1,
\]</div><p></p><p>那我们有：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\frac{\varphi(x+1)+\varphi(x-1)}{2}=\varphi(x)-1.
\]</div><p></p><p>移项变成：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\varphi(x+1)-2\varphi(x)+\varphi(x-1)=-2.
\]</div><p></p><p>左边是二阶差分。记一阶差分</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\Delta\varphi(x)=\varphi(x)-\varphi(x-1),
\]</div><p></p><p>则二阶差分就是 <span class="math inline">\(\Delta\varphi(x+1)-\Delta\varphi(x)\)</span>。方程变成：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\Delta\varphi(x+1)-\Delta\varphi(x)=-2.
\]</div><p></p><p><span class="math inline">\(\Delta\varphi\)</span> 每增加 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span> 一步就减少 <span class="math inline">\(2\)</span>。也就是说 <span class="math inline">\(\Delta\varphi\)</span> 是公差为 <span class="math inline">\(-2\)</span> 的等差数列。</p>
<p>由等差数列：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\Delta\varphi(x)=\Delta\varphi(1)-2(x-1).
\]</div><p></p><p>记为</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\Delta\varphi(x)=C-2x+2,
\]</div><p></p><p>其中 <span class="math inline">\(C=\Delta\varphi(1)\)</span> 是任意常数（取决于 <span class="math inline">\(\varphi(1)\)</span> 的选法）。</p>
<p>再求和得到 <span class="math inline">\(\varphi(x)\)</span>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\varphi(x)=\varphi(0)+\sum_{k=1}^{x}\Delta\varphi(k)
=\varphi(0)+\sum_{k=1}^{x}(C+2-2k).
\]</div><p></p><p>计算这个和：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\sum_{k=1}^{x}(C+2-2k)
=(C+2)x-2\cdot\frac{x(x+1)}{2}
=(C+2)x-x^2-x
=(C+1)x-x^2.
\]</div><p></p><p>所以</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\varphi(x)=\varphi(0)-x^2+(C+1)x.
\]</div><p></p><p>然后注意到一次项和常数项不会影响答案，所以我们得到 <span class="math inline">\(\varphi(x)=-x^2\)</span>。</p>
<p>应用停时定理得</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathbb E[T]=\varphi(k)-\mathbb E[\varphi(M_T)]
=(-k^2)-\left(0\cdot\frac{N-k}{N}-N^2\cdot\frac{k}{N}\right)
=k(N-k).
\]</div><p></p><p>是不是来点感觉了。</p>
<p>例题三：<a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/CF1025G" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">CF1025G Company Acquisitions</a></p>
<p>题目大意：有 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 个公司，一部分是活跃公司，每个非活跃公司都跟随恰好一个活跃公司。每回合随机等概率选出两个不同的活跃公司 <span class="math inline">\(x,y\)</span>，掷硬币决定谁收购谁：若 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span> 收购 <span class="math inline">\(y\)</span>，则 <span class="math inline">\(y\)</span> 变为非活跃并跟随 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span>，而原本跟随 <span class="math inline">\(y\)</span> 的所有公司全部重新变为活跃。当只剩一个活跃公司时停止，求期望天数。</p>
<p>设势能函数。一个局面只需要知道每个活跃公司手下有多少个跟随者。设 <span class="math inline">\(a_i\)</span> 为第 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 个活跃公司当前的跟随者数量，定义</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\varphi(\text{局面})=\sum_{i} f(a_i).
\]</div><p></p><p>对非终止局面计算一步期望变化。假设本回合选中的两个活跃公司的跟随数分别为 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span> 和 <span class="math inline">\(y\)</span>。</p>
<ul>
<li>若 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span> 收购 <span class="math inline">\(y\)</span>：<span class="math inline">\(x\)</span> 的跟随数变为 <span class="math inline">\(x+1\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(y\)</span> 不再活跃，而原来跟随 <span class="math inline">\(y\)</span> 的 <span class="math inline">\(y\)</span> 个公司各变成一个活跃公司，每个的跟随数为 <span class="math inline">\(0\)</span>。这一步之后，这两个“旧关键点”的势能和变为</li>
</ul>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[f(x+1)+y f(0).
\]</div><p></p><ul>
<li>若 <span class="math inline">\(y\)</span> 收购 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span>，对称地，势能和变为</li>
</ul>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[f(y+1)+x f(0).
\]</div><p></p><p>掷硬币等概率，所以这对关键点贡献的期望势能是</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\frac12\left(f(x+1)+y f(0)\right)+\frac12\left(f(y+1)+x f(0)\right).
\]</div><p></p><p>其余活跃公司的跟随数没有变，势能不变。原来这两家贡献的是 <span class="math inline">\(f(x)+f(y)\)</span>，因此整局势能的期望变化量为</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\frac12 f(x+1)+\frac12 y f(0)+\frac12 f(y+1)+\frac12 x f(0)-f(x)-f(y).
\]</div><p></p><p>我们希望一步之后势能期望减少 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span>，即</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathbb E[\varphi(A_{t+1})\mid A_t]=\varphi(A_t)-1.
\]</div><p></p><p>于是令上式等于 <span class="math inline">\(-1\)</span>。为方便取 <span class="math inline">\(f(0)=0\)</span>，方程化为</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\frac12 f(x+1)+\frac12 f(y+1)-f(x)-f(y)=-1.
\]</div><p></p><p>移项并拆开：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\left(\frac12 f(x+1)-f(x)\right)+\left(\frac12 f(y+1)-f(y)\right)=-1.
\]</div><p></p><p>这个式子要对任意的 <span class="math inline">\(x,y\)</span> 都成立。左边是只含 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span> 的一项与只含 <span class="math inline">\(y\)</span> 的一项之和，如果这个和恒为常数 <span class="math inline">\(-1\)</span>，那么每一项本身也必须是常数，并且两个常数之和为 <span class="math inline">\(-1\)</span>。于是存在常数 <span class="math inline">\(C\)</span> 使得</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\frac12 f(x+1)-f(x)=C
\]</div><p></p><p>对每个 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span> 成立，且 <span class="math inline">\(2C=-1\)</span>，即 <span class="math inline">\(C=-\frac12\)</span>。所以</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\frac12 f(x+1)-f(x)=-\frac12,
\]</div><p></p><p>乘以 <span class="math inline">\(2\)</span>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[f(x+1)=2f(x)-1.
\]</div><p></p><p>结合 <span class="math inline">\(f(0)=0\)</span>，递推两步就能看出规律：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[f(1)=2\cdot0-1=-1,\quad
f(2)=2(-1)-1=-3,\quad
f(3)=2(-3)-1=-7,\dots
\]</div><p></p><p>归纳得</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[f(k)=1-2^k.
\]</div><p></p><p>终止局面的势能。终止时只有一个活跃公司，它跟随了其余全部 <span class="math inline">\(n-1\)</span> 个公司，所以 <span class="math inline">\(a=n-1\)</span>，终态势能</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\varphi(A_T)=f(n-1)=1-2^{n-1}.
\]</div><p></p><p>停时定理给出</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathbb E[T]=\varphi(A_0)-\mathbb E[\varphi(A_T)].
\]</div><p></p><p>终态确定，所以</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathbb E[T]=\varphi(A_0)-\varphi(A_T)
=\sum_{i} \left(1-2^{a_i}\right)-\left(1-2^{n-1}\right).
\]</div><p></p><p>答案是：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathbb E[T]=\left(2^{n-1}-1\right)-\sum_{i}\left(2^{a_i}-1\right).
\]</div><p></p><p>其中 <span class="math inline">\(a_i\)</span> 是第 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 个活跃公司当前的跟随者数量，求和只遍历活跃公司。</p>
<p>例题四：<a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/CF1349D" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">CF1349D Slime and Biscuits</a></p>
<p>有 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 个人，第 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 个人有 <span class="math inline">\(a_i\)</span> 块饼干，总数 <span class="math inline">\(m=\sum_{i=1}^n a_i\)</span> 每回合随机等概率选一块饼干，再随机等概率选一个不是它当前主人的人，把这块饼干给那个人。求第一次出现“某个人拥有全部 <span class="math inline">\(m\)</span> 块饼干”的期望步数。</p>
<p>一个局面只需要知道每个人手里有多少块饼干。设第 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 个人有 <span class="math inline">\(a_i\)</span> 块，定义</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\varphi(\text{局面})=\sum_{i=1}^n f(a_i).
\]</div><p></p><p>对非终止局面计算一步的期望变化。假设本回合选中的饼干属于第 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 个人，概率为 <span class="math inline">\(a_i/m\)</span>；把它送给第 <span class="math inline">\(j\)</span> 个人，<span class="math inline">\(j\ne i\)</span>，概率为 <span class="math inline">\(1/(n-1)\)</span>。这一步之后</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[a_i\to a_i-1,\qquad a_j\to a_j+1.
\]</div><p></p><p>势能变化为</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[f(a_i-1)-f(a_i)+f(a_j+1)-f(a_j).
\]</div><p></p><p>于是</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
\mathbb E[\Delta\varphi]
&amp;=\sum_{i=1}^n \frac{a_i}{m}\cdot\frac1{n-1}
\sum_{j\ne i}\Bigl[f(a_i-1)-f(a_i)+f(a_j+1)-f(a_j)\Bigr].
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>拆成两部分。第一部分：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\sum_{i=1}^n \frac{a_i}{m}\cdot\frac1{n-1}\cdot(n-1)\bigl[f(a_i-1)-f(a_i)\bigr]
=
\sum_{i=1}^n \frac{a_i}{m}\bigl[f(a_i-1)-f(a_i)\bigr].
\]</div><p></p><p>第二部分交换求和：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
&amp;\sum_{i=1}^n \frac{a_i}{m}\cdot\frac1{n-1}
\sum_{j\ne i}\bigl[f(a_j+1)-f(a_j)\bigr]\\
&amp;=\frac1{n-1}\sum_{j=1}^n \bigl[f(a_j+1)-f(a_j)\bigr]
\sum_{i\ne j}\frac{a_i}{m}\\
&amp;=\frac1{n-1}\sum_{j=1}^n \bigl[f(a_j+1)-f(a_j)\bigr]\cdot\frac{m-a_j}{m}.
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>合并得到</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathbb E[\Delta\varphi]
=
\sum_{i=1}^n\left[
\frac{a_i}{m}\bigl(f(a_i-1)-f(a_i)\bigr)
+
\frac{m-a_i}{m(n-1)}\bigl(f(a_i+1)-f(a_i)\bigr)
\right].
\]</div><p></p><p>我们希望</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathbb E[\varphi(A_{t+1})\mid A_t]=\varphi(A_t)-1,
\]</div><p></p><p>也就是 <span class="math inline">\(\mathbb E[\Delta\varphi]=-1\)</span>。一个充分条件是每一项都贡献 <span class="math inline">\(-a_i/m\)</span>，因为</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\sum_{i=1}^n \frac{a_i}{m}=1.
\]</div><p></p><p>于是对每个 <span class="math inline">\(k=a_i\)</span>，要求</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\frac{k}{m}\bigl(f(k-1)-f(k)\bigr)
+
\frac{m-k}{m(n-1)}\bigl(f(k+1)-f(k)\bigr)
=
-\frac{k}{m}.
\]</div><p></p><p>乘以 <span class="math inline">\(m\)</span>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[k\bigl(f(k-1)-f(k)\bigr)
+
\frac{m-k}{n-1}\bigl(f(k+1)-f(k)\bigr)
=
-k.
\]</div><p></p><p>令</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\Delta(k)=f(k)-f(k-1),
\]</div><p></p><p>则</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[f(k-1)-f(k)=-\Delta(k),
\qquad
f(k+1)-f(k)=\Delta(k+1).
\]</div><p></p><p>代入得</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[-k\Delta(k)+\frac{m-k}{n-1}\Delta(k+1)=-k.
\]</div><p></p><p>移项：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\frac{m-k}{n-1}\Delta(k+1)=k\Delta(k)-k,
\]</div><p></p><p>所以</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\Delta(k+1)=\frac{(n-1)k\bigl(\Delta(k)-1\bigr)}{m-k}.
\]</div><p></p><p>取 <span class="math inline">\(f(0)=f(1)=0\)</span>，则 <span class="math inline">\(\Delta(1)=f(1)-f(0)=0\)</span>。从 <span class="math inline">\(k=1\)</span> 递推到 <span class="math inline">\(k=m-1\)</span>，再用</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[f(k+1)=f(k)+\Delta(k+1)
\]</div><p></p><p>前缀和即可得到所有 <span class="math inline">\(f(k)\)</span>。</p>
<p>终止局面：一个人有 <span class="math inline">\(m\)</span> 块，其余 <span class="math inline">\(n-1\)</span> 个人有 <span class="math inline">\(0\)</span> 块。因此终态势能</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\varphi(A_T)=f(m)+(n-1)f(0)=f(m).
\]</div><p></p><p>初始势能</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\varphi(A_0)=\sum_{i=1}^n f(a_i).
\]</div><p></p><p>停时定理条件满足。由</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathbb E[T]=\varphi(A_0)-\mathbb E[\varphi(A_T)]
\]</div><p></p><p>得到</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathbb E[T]=\sum_{i=1}^n f(a_i)-f(m)
\]</div><p></p><h3 id="总结">总结：</h3>
<p>输入：初始局面 <span class="math inline">\(A_0\)</span>，终止集合 <span class="math inline">\(\mathcal S\)</span>。</p>
<p>大概就是这样一个过程：</p>
<ol>
<li>设 <span class="math inline">\(\varphi(\text{局面})=\sum f(\text{分量})\)</span>。</li>
<li>对非终止局面 <span class="math inline">\(A\notin\mathcal S\)</span>，计算 <span class="math inline">\(\mathbb E[\varphi(A_{t+1})\mid A_t=A]\)</span>，令它等于 <span class="math inline">\(\varphi(A)-1\)</span>，整理成 <span class="math inline">\(f\)</span> 的递推/方程。</li>
<li>指定 <span class="math inline">\(f\)</span> 的一个初值（如 <span class="math inline">\(f(0)=0\)</span>）。</li>
<li>解出所有需要的 <span class="math inline">\(f(k)\)</span>。</li>
<li>计算 <span class="math inline">\(\varphi(A_0)\)</span> 和 <span class="math inline">\(\mathbb E[\varphi(A_T)]\)</span>；若终止局面势能确定，就是 <span class="math inline">\(\varphi(A_T)\)</span>。</li>
<li>输出 <span class="math inline">\(\mathbb E[T]=\varphi(A_0)-\mathbb E[\varphi(A_T)]\)</span>；若终止势能确定，则输出 <span class="math inline">\(\varphi(A_0)-\varphi(A_T)\)</span>。</li>
</ol>


</div>
<div class="clear"></div>
